messages:
Devon: quick async standup — short update (what I did / blockers / today)
Devon: Did: rolled out KV eviction tuning to prod canary at 50% traffic. Ran the batcher backlog reduction job overnight. Observed warmup QPS rise + 95p latency spike on text-gen routes.
Devon: Blocker: gen-95p alert started flapping ~6x in the last 15m. Not sure if metric noise or real latency regression from eviction thrash.
Devon: Today: coordinate rollback if needed, follow up on prefill job PR, and tune alert dedupe to reduce paging noise. Pinged oncall.

Maria: saw the same on my side — correlates with repeated kv eviction cycles on node-gpu-3. Logs show short-lived OOM-ish churn and cache misses. Taking lead (oncall).

Aj: ran some quick queries on grafana: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/abcd123/prod-gen?from=-1h shows kv_evictions spike at ~13:06 UTC and gen-95p up around the same window.

Olivia: Canary metrics: canary (50%) 95p jumped from ~220ms -> ~620ms, request QPS steady. KV miss rate increased ~3x. Looks like cold cache + eviction thrash, not model regression.

Ishaan: suggestion: short-term mitigation — enable KV warmup job for hot prefixes + increase batcher soft-limit to 32 for 1 hour to absorb variability. I can push a hotfix PR.

Aj: I've added a note to the runbook (/runbooks/slo-latency). Step 3 includes rollback steps. Also added a temporary suppression in alerting (5m dedupe) to avoid flapping pagers while we triage.

sre-bot: Alert: gen-95p-latency fired at 1776659002; 4 firing currently. Alert link: https://alerts.redwood/alerts/GEN-95P-1776659002

Maria: starting rollback to previous canary variant (tag: v2.3.1). Following runbook — copying commands here: 
Maria: ```
kubectl apply -f rollout-rollback.yaml
./scripts/verify_canary.sh --check 95p --threshold 300
```

Devon: thanks @Maria — I'll open the PR for the KV prefill/warmup job and assign reviewers @Olivia @Ishaan. Also holding off on batcher backlog surgery until post-stabilize.

Olivia: lgtm on the PR when you post it, I'll review and help monitor the canary metrics during rollback. Left one small doc nit.

Ishaan: starting warmup job now (one-off for top 500 prefixes), will post progress and logs here.

sre-bot: Deploy started: rollback job triggered by Maria at 1776659200. CI: https://ci.redwood/builds/4821

Maria: rollback complete — 95p dropped to ~180ms by 1776659500. Monitoring for the 15m window now.

Devon: moving batcher backlog task to tomorrow morning. No other blockers from my side.

Aj: created follow-up ticket SRE-1142 to add per-prefix KV hit/miss and eviction rate to our dashboards. Also suggested a 1-week experiment with prefill job + adjusted eviction thresholds.

Devon: big thanks everyone, especially @Maria for the quick rollback. Will follow up on PRs and tickets later today. :thumbsup:
